findings.evidence: Workflow steps 3 and 5 restate edit-size and delivery choices a capable model already makes once steps 1, 2 and 4 have settled the reader and the evidence.
findings.fix: Keep the non-obvious parts (mixed update-and-audit runs the audit first; placeholders instead of invented facts; full README, changed sections, or one line per stale claim). Move the generic 'rewrite if first success changes, otherwise edit the touched section' wording into references/section-checklist.md and record the move in docs/audit/recovery/crafting-effective-readmes/record.md; do not delete it.

findings.evidence: Gotchas cover monorepo installs, generated regions, registry rendering, anchors and badges, but not the crate-name case: a hyphenated Cargo package name is snake_case as a Rust identifier and often snake_case as the default binary, so a README can document the wrong command.
findings.fix: Add one Gotchas bullet: Cargo turns hyphens in the package name into underscores for the library path and the default binary name, so check [[bin]] name and the published command rather than copying the crate name; keep the existing install-name bullet.

findings.evidence: Routing says a template loads on top of the checklist for the chosen type, but does not say to skip the other three templates, so a create run can load all four.
findings.fix: After the routing sentence, add: load only the template for the type chosen in step 2; do not load the other templates in templates/.

findings.evidence: The OSS template offers three shields.io badge URLs as equal starting lines, while SKILL.md treats every badge as a claim that must match a real workflow, package or LICENSE.
findings.fix: Make the default 'no badge unless the matching file or published package was confirmed', and keep the three URL shapes as the forms to use only after that check.

findings.evidence: Eleven should-trigger queries and ten should-not-trigger queries, but the negatives are mostly distant (changelog, C4 diagram, docstrings, Fedora script) rather than near-miss README work such as a CONTRIBUTING.md or a docs-site install page.
findings.fix: Replace three easy negatives with near-misses that share README vocabulary but stay outside the description's exclusions, for example a CONTRIBUTING.md, a docs-site getting-started page, and a release-notes file, and keep the existing counts.

findings.evidence: Validation step 1 says to run the first-use path in a fresh clone, virtualenv or container, but gives no way to do that when the environment has no container runtime or network, beyond the later static label.
findings.fix: Add the fallback in step 2's place: if a clean clone or container cannot be started, run the static manifest and CI check immediately and label each claim static or unverified, and never claim executed.

findings.evidence: The environment-variables example uses DATABASE_URL and API_KEY as row labels, which a model can copy as if those were the project's real variables.
findings.fix: Rename the sample rows to <VARIABLE_NAME> and keep the instruction that the value column is a vault path, never a real secret.
